[[Harvest Soulreign]] is a [[Charr]] boss accompanied by [[Gordam Griefgiver]] in [[Against the Charr]]. He is the boss you have to defeat to complete the mission.

== Missions ==
*[[Charr Homelands]]
**{{NPC location|Against the Charr}}

(20 [[Blood Magic]], 20 [[Curses]] in [[Hard mode]])
* {{Skill icon|Faintheartedness}}
* {{Skill icon|Life Siphon}}
* {{Skill icon|Parasitic Bond}}
* {{Skill icon|Spiteful Spirit}} ([[elite]])

==Items dropped==
*[[Superb Charr Carving]]

== Notes ==
* It is difficult to capture [[Spiteful Spirit]] from this particular boss as the mission ends (and cutscene starts) if he is killed.  With careful timing it is possible to end the activation of [[Signet of Capture]] just as he dies.
